issues.title: [SECURITY & RELEASE] Define production release gate
issues.body:
## Outcome
Create a repeatable release gate so Skycar is not shipped with unresolved security, payment or state-management failures.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Auth and object-level permissions tested
- [ ] Booking transition tests pass
- [ ] Payment lifecycle tests pass
- [ ] Upload validation/access tested
- [ ] Secrets scan clean
- [ ] Error monitoring configured
- [ ] Backup/recovery approach documented
- [ ] Production env separation confirmed
- [ ] Rollback procedure documented
- [ ] PROJECT_STATUS.md reflects release readiness

## Depends on
Foundation and implemented production modules.

## Access checkpoint — 22 September 2026
Fresh connector read of [main branch metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/jimmoq-hopsup-Hoqde6/skycar-site/branches/main) now reports `protected: true` with required status checks enforced for `everyone`. The ten reported check contexts are application, integration, and the head/integration variants of care-entry-ui, care-postgres, combined-postgres and garage-database. Main remains at `d717760145ae438560a1d469c4f9500cdab5baef`.

This supersedes older comments describing main as unprotected. This run did not create or change that protection, and the branch metadata alone does not establish every rule, bypass restriction, or a tested merge/release control.

Pages publishing source/isolation, rollback, independent acceptance and hosted Supabase/auth/private-storage/device evidence remain separate requirements. Pages settings were not newly inspected in this checkpoint; do not infer their state from branch protection.

The immediate external-access request is a secure connection to an isolated Skycar Supabase development/test project. Verify the target is non-production before any mutation; use disposable accounts and no real customer data. The Supabase integration was offered to the user but was not connected at the time of this check. No passwords, API keys or credentials belong in this issue.

No code, branch rules, main revision, deployment, production database or customer data was changed by this access checkpoint. All acceptance criteria above remain open until their own evidence is verified.

issues.title: [NEXT MVP MILESTONE] One complete synthetic mobile repair booking → Garage record
issues.body:
## Goal
Demonstrate one complete **synthetic, non-billable mobile scratch-repair booking** across the real customer, technician and Garage flows, without mocked responses at the integration boundary. This is the immediate next MVP acceptance milestone. This does **not** authorize deployment, real payments, contacting customers or modifying protected release controls.

## Required customer-to-technician sequence
1. Customer opens repair request, selects own vehicle (or enters vehicle details), captures/uploads damage photos to private storage, and submits the job. Verify records remain customer-private; return an explicit request status.
2. A Skycar-reviewed repair quote with scope and total AUD amount becomes visible to that customer; quote is linked to the submitted request. Technician selection requires an eligible, currently active and authorized technician, with no cross-customer data leakage.
3. Customer selects the technician and requests a **mobile repair at work or home** with address/appointment preference. Operations confirms availability explicitly; the application does not imply a booking is confirmed before capacity is checked.
4. Assigned technician sees the job privately, starts work and uploads completion evidence. The customer sees accurate status and confirms completion or reports a private issue.
5. Customer's Garage shows the correct vehicle, repair/booking history, quote amount, photos/evidence where permitted, completed status and associated record. Verify that completion creates only one record per effective action.

## Owners and non-overlap
- **Developer 1, backend/security:** sole writer for shared database migrations, RLS/auth permissions, booking commands and shared contracts. PR #69 / issue #66 security corrections must pass independent review before this full stack is accepted.
- **Developer 2, customer experience:** photo submission, quote/technician selection, address/appointment request and Garage navigation/UI. Use mocks only during isolated frontend work; connected milestone acceptance must use the real API.
- **Developer 3, technician experience:** assigned job inbox, availability interface, start/complete controls and evidence UI. Do not change shared database logic.
- **Developer 4, payments:** sandbox/non-billable amount display and payment-contract QA only; no live charges, payout, payment activation or schema edits.
- **Developer 5, independent QA:** own acceptance test cases, reproduction scripts and evidence; do not approve own implementation. Coordinate with Developer 1 before touching shared test harness.
- **Product owner / release gate:** accept the single sample journey after independent evidence; no merge or hosted deployment without separate approval.

## Acceptance checklist
- [ ] Customer damage photos submitted privately and persisted to the intended request/vehicle.
- [ ] Correct quote appears; duplicate/replayed commands do not duplicate records.
- [ ] Customer selects an authorized technician, asks for mobile service at work/home, and receives an explicit confirmed appointment after operations-capacity approval.
- [ ] Technician can start/complete only assigned work; unrelated technician, unrelated customer and revoked role/link denied.
- [ ] Completion images/private issue stay appropriately private; customer confirms completion (and issue path separately tested).
- [ ] Completed job is visible under the correct vehicle in Garage with consistent history, amount and status.
- [ ] End-to-end test uses an isolated disposable PostgreSQL database and synthetic photos/identities; audit/history counts are checked for exactly-once effects.
- [ ] Parallel booking/selection and completion race tests show no deadlock or duplicate capacity; role-change replay, same-key conflict and account/vehicle transfer/archive deny correctly.
- [ ] Tests prove iPhone/mobile entry, validation, error/retry, account switch and guest route separately.
- [ ] Developer 5 provides independent QA verdict and actual CI links. Staging and real-device acceptance remain gated on issue #8. No live charges, sends or dispatch.

## Blocking dependencies
#66 / PR #69 authorization and lock ordering; #53 availability contract and owner handoff; #50 file-level coordination; #8 staging/security/release readiness; #14 existing MVP product direction.

## Completion evidence
Add exact tested git SHA, CI run links, test identities (non-secret aliases only), screenshots with private data redacted, failures and known limitations. Do not mark milestone complete on the basis of mocked frontend paths alone.

issues.title: [SPRINT 1 / CONTROL] Executive tracker — integration, security, QA and agent readiness
issues.body:
## Objective
Establish an auditable Sprint 1 for the existing Skycar V2 service-to-Garage MVP. This is a coordination index, not an authorization to implement or ship.

## Priority sequence
1. P0: integration and migration dependency map (#83, #84, #85, #81, #82, #50).
2. P0: independent security verification (#66 / PR #69 and follow-on #72–#74).
3. P0: reproducible CI and synthetic customer-to-technician-to-Garage acceptance (#71).
4. P1: isolated staging/security/recovery readiness (#8).
5. P1: AI specialist runtime and safety review (PR #86).

## Definition of done
- [ ] Each workstream has named accountable human/agent session and non-overlapping file scope before code writes.
- [ ] Integration candidate is pinned to a precise SHA, migration sequence and CI evidence; no unreviewed merges.
- [ ] Security issues have independent PASS or blocking findings.
- [ ] #71 has a synthetic real-API acceptance verdict, with known limitations.
- [ ] Staging prerequisites and rollback controls documented; no hosted changes.
- [ ] AI team bootstrap is reviewed without assuming agents are running.
- [ ] Executive handoff records completed, blocked and next actions with evidence links.

## Existing authority
#8 release gate, #28 role charter, #50 coordination, #71 MVP acceptance. Do not supersede existing accepted decisions.

## Mandatory controls
- Planning, read-only audit, isolated local/disposable tests and draft review artifacts only.
- No merge, deployment, hosted migration, production data access, real payments, customer messages, role grants or branch-protection changes.
- Independent reviewer must not approve their own implementation. Record exact SHA, reproducible commands, CI URLs, failures and remaining risks.
- Coordinate file ownership through #50; only the designated backend writer may modify shared migrations/contracts. No writes to other developers' branches.
- Require separate product-owner authorization and #8 release gates for protected actions.

issues.body:
## Scope
QA execution plan for existing #71, using isolated disposable identities, photos and PostgreSQL; real connected APIs at integration boundary (not mocked). Do not contact customers or bill anyone.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Customer vehicle/photo request, quote, eligible technician selection, address/preferred slot and explicit operations confirmation verified.
- [ ] Technician private inbox, start/complete and completion evidence verified.

- [ ] Record staging/physical-device gaps against #8; do not claim hosted acceptance without proof.

Dependencies: #71, #66, #53, #50, #8.

## Mandatory controls
- Planning, read-only audit, isolated local/disposable tests and draft review artifacts only.
- No merge, deployment, hosted migration, production data access, real payments, customer messages, role grants or branch-protection changes.

- Coordinate file ownership through #50; only the designated backend writer may modify shared migrations/contracts. No writes to other developers' branches.
- Require separate product-owner authorization and #8 release gates for protected actions.

## Sprint 1 candidate handoff — 10 November 2026
Candidate for synthetic real-API journey: PR #84 head `29dc4679b722f294b3cf554ba80f06ebdbf51101`, **pending independent QA/Security acceptance**. Do not infer full E2E completion from green CI: browser CI uses demo mode and SQL harness uses auth/storage stubs. Verify connected customer photo request, reviewed quote, technician selection, capacity-confirmed appointment, assigned technician completion and exactly-once Garage record. Include cross-account, revoked-role, account-switch and mobile negatives; record exact test SHA, screenshots with private data redacted and limitations. No live payments, dispatch, hosted installs or deployment.

## Executive acceptance directive — 11 November 2026
**Priority: P0 single-job vertical slice.** Freeze feature expansion and evaluate one synthetic mobile scratch-repair request from customer through technician completion and Garage history. The accepted business sequence is: (1) customer chooses vehicle and uploads private damage photos; (2) submits request; (3) Skycar-reviewed AUD quote appears and customer accepts; (4) customer selects authorized eligible technician and requests home/work address + preferred slot; (5) operations/capacity check explicitly confirms booking; (6) assigned technician privately sees job, starts work, uploads completion evidence and marks complete; (7) customer confirms or raises private issue; (8) exactly one history record appears for the correct vehicle in Garage. 

**Required evidence per step:** route/screen, connected API or RPC, relevant table/storage object, expected state transition, and screenshot/test evidence. Independent QA must test error/retry, rejected quote, unavailable technician, double-booking, duplicate/replay, wrong customer/technician, role revocation, account switch and mobile viewport. Distinguish implemented vs missing functionality; create isolated draft PRs for gaps, with one designated backend/migration writer via #50. Record SHA, tests, CI URLs, redacted screenshots, PASS/BLOCK and remaining risks. **Do not claim completion from demo-mode browser tests or stubbed auth/storage.** No production access, real payment, customer contact, hosted migration, merge or deployment without separate approval.

**Definition of DONE:** one synthetic connected customer→technician→Garage journey is demonstrated end to end, independent QA and Security sign off on the exact SHA, and Product Owner reviews the evidence. Anything less is IN PROGRESS/BLOCKED.
